## Notes

Re-measured to settle the drift the check flagged, and committed with `REFRESH_BASELINE=1` — the deliberate acceptance
recorded here. Mean and p95 moved by ~1 ms; **p99 roughly doubled** on four requests (`FetchShowcases` 15 → 24 ms,
`ScheduleShowcase` 15 → 27, `PollShowcase` 12 → 24, `RemoveShowcase` 13 → 24), which the 50% tolerance caught and the
refresh accepted. Those slower tails are now the recorded reference, but the profiles' own thresholds do not move with
it — 5x these values still lands under their 200 ms p99 floor — so the drift check is what tracks the tail now: a
further p99 rise of up to ~1.5x these values (the tolerance, floored) passes it, and only one beyond that re-flags, and
the tail's cause is still unexplained (parked as an idea in `docs/ideas.md`).

Same environment and comparable load as the 2026-09-27 record (colima, 10 vCPU / ~16 GiB, 124 vs 122 workload units/s,
~233 vs 229 rps); the knee remains unmeasured at the 200-unit/s calibration ceiling, and mean/p95 of 7/10 ms compare
with that record's 6/9.
